title: Recent Shopping and the Finch Circle Courtesy Reissue — Training Questions
content:
**Rule.** For a courtesy reissue of a Finch Note in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the courtesy shopping days are 7 when the customer's latest completed Marlowe & Finch purchase was completed 30 calendar days or fewer before the request date, 3 when 31 to 90 days before, and 0 otherwise.

**Which purchase is looked at?** The customer's latest completed purchase record, by its completed date, under Merchandise Purchases.

**Completed exactly 30 days before the request?** 30 days or fewer: 7.

**31 days before?** 3.

**90 days before?** Still 3.

**91 days before, or no completed purchase at all?** 0.

| Calendar days from the latest completed purchase to the request date | Courtesy shopping days |
|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | 7 |
| 31 to 90 | 3 |
| 91 or more, or none | 0 |
